images.filename: Charles Landseer - The Eve of the Battle of Edge Hill, 1642 - Google Art Project.jpg
images.caption: King Charles I stands centre wearing the blue sash of the Order of the Garter; Prince Rupert of the Rhine is sat next to him and Lord Lindsey stands next to the king resting his commander's baton against the map.
